# DendriticInContextLearning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A single-layer spiking neural network architecture where dendritic compartments enable in-context learning without weight updates, using local synaptic plasticity. Demonstrates that complex learning tasks can be performed in a single-layer spiking network, reducing hardware complexity for neuromorphic processors.
